The veteran floor general hasn't been very productive through nine games this month, during which he's averaged 10.4 points, 4.4 assists, 3.6 rebounds and 1.2 steals across 27.3 minutes per contest.

news.headline: Fox contributed six points (3-10 FG, 0-5 3Pt), two rebounds, two assists and two steals in 34 minutes during Tuesday's 105-93 loss to the Pistons.
news.story: Fox has been held in check in back-to-back appearances, and he never found a rhythm against Detroit's physical perimeter defense. news.headline: George supplied 10 points (3-12 FG, 1-7 3Pt, 3-3 FT), four rebounds, one assist, one block and three steals across 23 minutes before fouling out of Wednesday's 105-101 loss to Denver.
news.story: The four combined steals and blocks were George's best showing since Nov. 4, when he racked up four pilfers against the Bucks. The veteran forward's offensive contributions have been erratic of late, and he's scored 10 points or fewer in three of his last six games, averaging 18.3 points, 5.3 boards, 3.3 threes, 2.2 assists and 1.5 steals during that stretch.

news.headline: Pritchard had 15 points (6-11 FG, 3-6 3Pt), one rebound and two assists over 30 minutes during Wednesday's 105-101 loss to the Nuggets.
news.story: Pritchard has scored at least 14 points in four of his last five appearances, with 15 triples during that stretch. However, his assists have fluctuated considerably, and he's contributed little defensively. His perimeter shooting remains his primary fantasy asset, while Boston's crowded rotation limits his overall ceiling.

news.headline: Payton Pritchard sinks a triple for Celtics
Pritchard racked up 21 points (7-16 FG, 4-11 3Pt, 3-3 FT), four rebounds and five assists in 32 minutes during Monday's 115-105 loss to the Magic.
news.story: Pritchard had his most productive game since late October, a welcome relief for fantasy managers. While it was good to see him doing what he does best, Pritchard remains outside the top 100 this season, averaging 13.6 points, 3.2 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 2.4 three-pointers in 27.0 minutes per game. Assuming Boston remains relatively healthy, expect to see Pritchard flirting with top-100 value ROS.
